name: kettle-desktop
description: Native macOS shell for Kettle's local-first review desk.
author: Charles Berret

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check lib/core-contract.js && node --check lib/sidecar-startup.js && node --check lib/ritual-parity.js && node --check app/api.js && node --check app/app.js && node --check scripts/check-package.js && node --check scripts/finalize-package.js && node --check scripts/smoke-sidecar.js && bash -n scripts/build-sidecar.sh && bash -n scripts/check-core-source.sh
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run test:unit
scripts.package:forge: node scripts/check-package.js --preflight && electron-forge package && node scripts/finalize-package.js && node scripts/check-package.js
scripts.package:shell: npm run smoke:sidecar && npm run package:forge
scripts.package: KETTLE_RELEASE_BUILD=1 npm run build:sidecar && npm run smoke:sidecar && npm run package:forge
scripts.make: KETTLE_RELEASE_BUILD=1 npm run build:sidecar && npm run smoke:sidecar && npm run package:forge && electron-forge make --skip-package
